description:
Promote calm, and earn with purpose.

At JettProof, we believe every person deserves to feel calm and confident.

Our Australian-made sensory clothing and bedding are designed to support self-regulation and emotional wellbeing.

Now, you can help us share that calm with the world.


Join our Affiliate Program and become part of a caring community of therapists, educators, and parents who genuinely make a difference. When you share JettProof products using your unique affiliate link, you’ll earn a commission for every purchase made through your referral

It’s a meaningful way to grow your income while supporting families who need sensory solutions they can trust.

JettProof® Affiliate Program — Terms & Conditions



Effective Date: 29 Oct 2025


Welcome to the JettProof® Affiliate Program. By enrolling, you agree to the following Terms and Conditions, designed to ensure fairness, transparency, and legal compliance for all parties.



1. 

Eligibility



To join the JettProof® Affiliate Program, you must:


  • Be at least 18 years old.

  • Operate a valid website, social media account, or other approved digital channel.

  • Accurately and ethically represent the JettProof® brand and products.

  • Provide truthful information in your application.

  • Not be a direct competitor or otherwise in conflict with JettProof’s interests.



JettProof® reserves the right to approve or reject any application at its sole discretion, and is not obliged to provide reasons for rejection.




2. 

Affiliate Responsibilities



By participating, you agree to:


  • Promote JettProof® products truthfully and not make misleading or unsubstantiated claims.

  • Use only promotional materials provided or explicitly approved by JettProof®.

  • Adhere to all applicable laws, regulations (including the Australian Consumer Law and digital advertising standards), and platform guidelines.

  • Maintain JettProof®’s brand integrity and not engage in conduct that could harm the brand’s reputation.

  • Disclose your affiliate relationship clearly in all posts, emails, or promotions as required by law (e.g., #ad, #sponsored).





3. 

Affiliate Links, Coupons & Tracking



  • You will receive a unique affiliate link after approval. You may also be assigned a custom coupon code.

  • Attribution: If a customer clicks multiple affiliate links, the most recent (last click) receives the commission.

  • Tracking: Commission is based on cookies and browser/device settings. JettProof® is not responsible for lost tracking due to ad blockers, privacy tools, or user actions outside our control.

  • Cookie window: 60 days. Sales completed within this window after clicking your link are attributed to you.





4. 

Commissions


  • Standard commission: 10% of the product subtotal (excluding shipping, GST, and any fees/returns).

  • Commission is payable on new customer referrals only. Orders placed by existing customers do not qualify for affiliate commission.

  • No commission for cancelled, refunded, or fraudulent orders.

  • You cannot earn commission on your own orders, or those placed by immediate family or household members.

  • If both a coupon code and affiliate link are used, only one commission is paid per order.





5. 

Payments



  • Minimum payout: AUD $50.00.

  • Paid monthly, approximately 30 days after month-end, to allow for returns/chargebacks.

  • Payments are made via PayPal to the email address specified in your account. You are responsible for keeping your payment information accurate and up-to-date.

  • Affiliates are solely responsible for reporting and paying any taxes due on their earnings.





6. 

Prohibited Activities



You must NOT:


  • Use your own affiliate links to purchase JettProof® products (self-referrals).

  • Use unauthorised coupon codes, fake discounts, or misleading offers.

  • Portray yourself as an employee, agent, or partner of JettProof® (unless expressly approved in writing).

  • Use spam, unsolicited messaging, coupon/discount sites, or misleading ads to drive traffic.

  • Bid on JettProof® trademarks (or misspellings/variations) in any search engine, paid ad, or domain.

  • Engage in any activity that violates applicable laws or damages the JettProof® brand.

  • Copy, modify, or create derivative works from JettProof®’s intellectual property without explicit approval.



Violation of any of these rules may result in immediate termination from the program and forfeiture of unpaid commissions.




7. 

Intellectual Property



  • All logos, images, content, and promotional materials remain the property of JettProof Pty Ltd (ABN 16 082 434 795).

  • You are granted a limited, non-exclusive, revocable licence to use approved materials solely for affiliate promotion, and only for as long as you remain in the program.

  • You may not register domains, social handles, or advertising accounts containing the JettProof® name, trademarks, or confusingly similar terms.





8. 

Confidentiality & Data



  • Any non-public information you receive as part of the program (e.g., upcoming products, pricing) must remain confidential unless we make it public.

  • You agree not to collect or use customer data for any purpose except as expressly authorised by JettProof®.





9.

10. 

Termination



  • Either party may terminate your participation at any time, for any reason, with or without notice.

  • Upon termination, you must immediately remove all JettProof® links, banners, and materials from your channels.

  • Valid commissions earned before termination (and not subject to dispute) will be paid out in the next scheduled payment cycle.

  • JettProof® may withhold unpaid commissions in the event of suspected fraud, abuse, or breach of these terms.

Contact
